statement.notes: Only the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field was requested for extraction. The value was directly available as a single line item in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income to net cash provided by operating activities' section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. The supplementary tables contain related information (e.g., operating lease details) but do not provide a separate or additive component for depreciation and amortization in the cash flow context. Therefore, the array contains a single element mapping directly to the source label.
